newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin ends down a cent after brief session.
newsitem.headline: KL tin ends down a cent after brief session.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price ended down a cent at 14.24 ringgit ($5.73) a kg after a brief trading session due to lack of participation, traders said.
Traders noted bids for 83 tonnes against offers for 89 tonnes at the opening, with overnight gains on the London Metal Exchange (LME) having no impact on the market.
Final turnover was 79 tonnes, down from 108 on Thursday. Buyers were from Europe, Japan and Malaysia, traders said.
The local price premium over LME narrowed to $20 a tonne against $50 previously.
